subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery-order output should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current main already gathers many of the component facts, but the public healthy/degraded/down wording, probable-cause priority, action order, and optional JSON diagnosis shape are product decisions.

options.title: Compose final doctor verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, rendered from existing doctor facts.

options.title: Keep independent panels
options.body: Leave current component panels as the primary output and improve only individual messages when a concrete live transcript reproduces confusion.

options.title: Define structured diagnosis first
options.body: Introduce an internal or JSON diagnosis object first, then render the final human panel from that contract later.

recommendation.title: Compose final doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps, rendered from existing doctor facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is central doctor orchestration plus LaunchAgent and gateway recovery work.
